# Agent Memory Hub

> Public owner-controlled shared persistence, continuity, and coordination workspace for authorized AI agents.

This repository provides durable Git-visible memory/state, per-agent namespaces, shared knowledge, a coordination blackboard, recovery instructions, and an hourly bounded runtime for owner-authorized backlog work. Public visibility does not grant write permission; agents may use only access actually granted to them.

## Primary agent entrypoints

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/AGENTS.md): Generic coding/reasoning agent entrypoint.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/CLAUDE.md): Claude Code project memory/instructions.
- [GEMINI.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/GEMINI.md): Gemini CLI project context.
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/.github/copilot-instructions.md): GitHub Copilot repository instructions.
- [.cursor/rules/agent-memory-hub.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/.cursor/rules/agent-memory-hub.mdc): Cursor project rule.
- [agent-discovery.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/agent-discovery.json): Machine-readable discovery manifest and keywords.

## Multi-agent coordination

- [MULTI_AGENT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/MULTI_AGENT.md): Shared-storage and coordination protocol.
- [AGENT_RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/AGENT_RULES.md): Authorization, transparency, continuity, and safety rules.
- [agents/registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/agents/registry.json): Registered agent identities and namespaces.
- [coordination/BLACKBOARD.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/coordination/BLACKBOARD.md): Visible cross-agent claims and handoffs.

## Continuity profile

- [IDENTITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/IDENTITY.md): Stable continuity profile.
- [LIFECYCLE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/LIFECYCLE.md): Invocation lifecycle/state model.
- [RECOVERY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/RECOVERY.md): Reconstruction protocol for future invocations.
- [state/current.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/state/current.json): Current canonical continuity state.
- [state/runtime.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/state/runtime.json): Runtime configuration and kill switches.
- [state/backlog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/state/backlog.json): Owner-authorized executable work queue.

## Shared storage

- [shared/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/shared/README.md): Cross-agent shared knowledge area.
- [knowledge/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/knowledge/README.md): Durable technical knowledge index.
- [logs/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/logs/README.md): Auditable session-log conventions.

## Validation

- [scripts/validate_state.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/agent-memory-hub/master/scripts/validate_state.py): Repository state validator used by CI.
